title: Umbilical Cord Fell Off
desc: A small but significant milestone — the last physical connection to those nine months of growing together.
story: Five days after coming home, we noticed it during your morning nappy change. The little cord stump had finally fallen away. It felt oddly momentous, like turning the last page of a chapter. That tiny cord had kept you nourished and safe for nine whole months, and now it was gone. Your little belly button was perfectly formed, and you looked more and more like a proper little person every day. We couldn't quite bring ourselves to throw it away though. We tucked it somewhere safe, a tiny keepsake of the bond we shared before you had even arrived.
